info.title: IapAuther
info.description: CLI tool for authenticating with Google Cloud Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP), supporting both token issuance and MCP C# SDK stdio-to-HTTP proxy modes.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Authenticate with Google Cloud Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) — issue tokens, emit headersHelper JSON, or run as a stdio-to-HTTP MCP proxy.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: token
commands.description: Mint an IAP authentication token (OIDC ID token or self-signed SA JWT) and print it to stdout.

options.name: --audience
options.description: Token audience: IAP OAuth client ID (LB-backed IAP) or service URL. Defaults to the origin of UPSTREAM_URL, or the exact endpoint for signjwt (pass <origin>/* for all paths).

options.name: --credentials
options.description: Credential source: auto, adc, impersonate, oauth, signjwt. [default: auto]

options.name: --impersonate-service-account
options.description: Target service account email (impersonate mode mints an ID token; signjwt mode signs a self-signed JWT).

options.name: --credential-file
options.description: Path to a Google service account JSON key or ADC credential file.

options.name: --oauth-client-id
options.description: Desktop OAuth client ID (env: IAP_AUTHER_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID / IAP_MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID).

options.name: --oauth-client-secret
options.description: Desktop OAuth client secret (env: IAP_AUTHER_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET / IAP_MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET).

options.name: --token-store
options.description: OAuth refresh token store: auto (OS credential store with file fallback), os (OS credential store only), or file. [default: auto]

options.name: --no-browser
options.description: Do not automatically open a browser during OAuth login; print the URL to log output (stderr by default) instead. [default: False]

options.name: --log-level
options.description: Log level: debug, info, warn, error. [default: warn]

options.name: --log-output
options.description: Log destination: stderr (default), stdout, or both (including stdout alongside stderr; breaks machine-readable stdout in token/mcp-proxy unless debugging). [default: stderr]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: raw (token only), header (Proxy-Authorization: Bearer ...), or json. [default: raw]

arguments.name: UPSTREAM_URL
arguments.description: Optional upstream URL used to derive --audience when --audience is omitted.

commands.name: mcp-proxy
commands.description: Bridge a stdio MCP client to an IAP-protected HTTP MCP server using the MCP C# SDK.

options.name: --audience
options.description: Token audience: IAP OAuth client ID (LB-backed IAP) or service URL. Defaults to the origin of UPSTREAM_URL, or the exact endpoint for signjwt (pass <origin>/* for all paths).

options.name: --credentials
options.description: Credential source: auto, adc, impersonate, oauth, signjwt. [default: auto]

options.name: --impersonate-service-account
options.description: Target service account email (impersonate mode mints an ID token; signjwt mode signs a self-signed JWT).

options.name: --oauth-client-id
options.description: Desktop OAuth client ID (env: IAP_AUTHER_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID / IAP_MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID).

options.name: --log-output
options.description: Log destination: stderr (default), stdout, or both (including stdout alongside stderr; breaks machine-readable stdout in token/mcp-proxy unless debugging). [default: stderr]

options.name: --downstream-auth
options.description: Value forwarded as the upstream Authorization header; supports env:VAR_NAME indirection.

options.name: --refresh-margin
options.description: Refresh the ID token this long before expiry (e.g. 5m, 300s). [default: 5m]

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Upstream timeout: total for JSON responses, idle (between reads) for SSE streams (e.g. 120s, 2m). [default: 120s]

options.name: --transport
options.description: Upstream MCP transport mode: auto, streamable-http, or sse. [default: auto]

arguments.name: UPSTREAM_URL
arguments.description: Full URL of the IAP-protected HTTP MCP endpoint.
